_about: Parity guard of the web front-end (tests/web/test_parity_guard.py). Every address the core's describe() lists must be bound to a control on the page (an element with data-address) or match a pattern below, with the reason it is absent. Patterns are fnmatch globs. A slice that binds an address removes it from here (the guard fails while a bound address is still listed, and on patterns that match nothing).

absent.global.channel: channel buttons select the channel (face slice)
absent.global.edit_all: edit rack header: edit all (edit rack slice)
absent.ch?.mute: MUTE latch and channel buttons (face slice)
absent.ch?.name: strip patch-name tabs (face slice)
absent.ch?.osc.*: strips (tune, decay) and the edit rack oscillator section
absent.ch?.noise.*: edit rack noise section and envelope fader bank
absent.ch?.mix.*: strip level fader, CTRL knob and the edit rack mix section
absent.pattern.?.empty: pattern buttons show empty patterns (patterns slice)
absent.morph.*: sound morph knob, learn A / learn B (programs and morph slice)
absent.preset.*: preset display, browser and menu (preset slice)
absent.midi.*: MIDI LED, MIDI learn and the setup sheet MIDI tab (MIDI slice)
absent.pref.ai.*: AI drum generator page and setup sheet AI tab (AI slice)
